Qatar offers Pakistani travellers free 30-day visa on arrival under four conditions

Web Desk 7:10 PM | October 31, 2026

Pakistani citizens can obtain a free tourist visa on arrival in Qatar for stays of up to 30 days, provided they meet four requirements set by the Qatari Ministry of Interior.

According to the ministry, the visa can be issued for a maximum of 30 days or for a shorter period depending on the visitor's hotel reservation in the country.

Travellers must hold a passport valid for at least six months, a confirmed return ticket, a hotel booking and proof of sufficient funds for the stay.

The rules were announced by the ministry on Saturday.
